resources.string: Enter 1–10 valid email addresses, separated by commas or lines.
One address per line, or separate with commas or semicolons. Duplicates are removed; recipients cannot see the other addresses.

Optional for this recording. Configure your own SMTP account. If the server rejects an address, the message is not sent to anyone. Review or correct the list in Outbox. Server acceptance does not prove inbox delivery.

After this recording is saved, email the video to:
%1$s

The local original is kept. Sending may wait for network or Android background scheduling.
